Preparing reports, spreadsheets and other business documents.

Assisting with procurement, supplier management and related administration.

You will ideally have:

Previous experience in an accounts, bookkeeping, finance administration or similar position.

Experience using Xero accounting software.

Good Microsoft Excel skills and confidence using Microsoft Office.

Strong numerical ability with excellent accuracy and attention to detail.

Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

A proactive, practical approach and the confidence to work independently.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

A professional and discreet approach when handling confidential information.

Desirable, but not essential:

An AAT qualification or equivalent accounting experience.

Experience assisting with payroll, VAT returns or management accounts.

Previous experience working within an SME or multi-business environment.

Knowledge of UK finance and employment administration requirements.

This is a permanent, part-time position offering approximately 25-35 hours per week, depending on the successful candidate and the requirements of the business.

Salary will be dependent on experience and the skills the successful candidate can bring to the position, with flexibility for those offering particularly relevant experience.
